language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The wooden spoon is initially on the table (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot closes its gripper around the spoon and lifts it from the table (frames 120–145, wrist_image and left_ego_image), then carries it to the open drawer. After release, the spoon visibly rests inside the drawer while the empty gripper withdraws (frames 208–220, wrist_image). No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or unintended object displacement is established.
